findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and its age at cessation is recorded as 38.2 years (13936 days).

The accounts are recorded as of unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded; the last accounts were made up to 31 December 2023.
The confirmation statement is recorded as of unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded; the last statement was made up to 5 March 2025.
One person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, a company holding 75 to 100 percent of shares.
No charges are registered against the company.
The register records 2 current officers: one director, E. GREEN, appointed 11 May 2022, and one other officer.
The current director, E. GREEN, has 11 other appointments recorded: 8 active, 2 dissolved and 1 in liquidation, and the register notes this list may be incomplete.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations were filed since 24 October 2025.
